formations.name: Alluvium & Dhekiajuli
formations.lithology: Unconsolidated sands, gravels, pebbles, soft clays
formations.hazardDescription: Surface hole boulder beds causing bit bouncing & hole enlargement.

formations.name: Girujan Clay Formation
formations.lithology: Variegated clays, soft silty mudstones, mottled claystone
formations.hazardDescription: Highly reactive smectite clays causing swelling, bit balling, and tight hole during trips.

formations.name: Tipam Sandstone Formation
formations.lithology: Coarse to medium grained permeable sandstone with minor shale intercalations
formations.hazardDescription: High permeability thief zones prone to differential sticking when overbalanced (>0.15 SG).

formations.name: Surma Group (Transition)
formations.lithology: Interbedded hard calcareous sandstones, siltstones, dark shales
formations.hazardDescription: Microfractured hard stringers causing rapid torque fluctuations and ROP drops.

formations.name: Barail Coal-Shale & Sandstone
formations.lithology: Sub-bituminous coal seams, carbonaceous shales, tight fine sandstones
formations.hazardDescription: CRITICAL HAZARD ZONE: Sub-hydrostatic depleted sands adjacent to overpressured coal beds. Narrow drilling margin (0.05 SG). Prone to massive mud loss followed by sudden gas influx!

formations.name: Kopili Shale Formation
formations.lithology: Dark splintery fissile shale with calcareous marl bands
formations.hazardDescription: Abnormally high pore pressure sloughing shale prone to packoff, tight hole, and pipe sticking.

formations.name: Sylhet Limestone (Eocene)
formations.lithology: Fossiliferous massive crystalline limestone, dolomitic dolomite
formations.hazardDescription: Cavernous vugular porosity prone to total lost circulation (dry drilling risks).

formations.name: Basal Sandstone & Basement
formations.lithology: Arkosic gritty quartzite & granitic metamorphic basement complex
formations.hazardDescription: Abrasive hard rock causing severe PDC cutter wear and high vibrations.

events.summary: Sudden total loss of circulation (48 m³/hr) while drilling 8-1/2" section at 3,480m.
events.rootCause: Drilled into induced fractures in sub-hydrostatic Barail sandstone with excessive ECD (1.29 SG vs 1.22 SG fracture gradient).
events.recommendedMitigation: Immediately reduce flow rate to 1,200 LPM, spot 45 bbl heavy LCM pill (coarse nut plug 25 ppb + calcium carbonate 15 ppb), decrease active mud weight to 1.21 SG.
events.actionTaken: Pumped 50 bbl LCM pill, hesitated for 4 hours, restored circulation at 75% flow rate. Cased off with 7" liner at 3,510m.

sourceReport.title: Well Completion Report: NWIS-Calire-02 (Duliajan Field)
sourceReport.section: Section 4.3: Lost Circulation Incident at 3,480m MD
sourceReport.excerpt: At 14:30 hrs while drilling ahead in Barail Coal-Shale at 3,480m, active pit volume showed rapid depletion (-48 m3/hr). Flow out sensor dropped to 0%. SPP dropped from 2,850 psi to 1,400 psi indicating loss of hydrostatic head.

events.summary: Severe 18 bbl gas influx during connection at 3,495m. Shut-in drill pipe pressure (SIDPP) 450 psi, SICP 620 psi.
events.rootCause: Swabbing during pipe connection combined with underbalanced mud weight (1.18 SG) against 1.27 SG Barail gas sandstone pore pressure.
events.recommendedMitigation: Shut in well immediately on Annular BOP, calculate Kill Mud Weight (1.26 SG), circulate kick out using Wait & Weight method with choke manifold monitoring.
events.actionTaken: Well shut in, killed using 1.26 SG potassium-chloride polymer mud, displaced hole completely before resuming drilling.

sourceReport.title: Daily Drilling Report #32: NWIS-Colive-04
sourceReport.section: Well Control Log: Connection Gas Influx at 3,495m
sourceReport.excerpt: Flow check positive after breaking joint at 3,495m. Well flowed at 6 bbl/min. Annular preventer closed in 28 seconds. SIDPP: 450 psi, SICP: 620 psi. Pit gain: 18.2 bbl.

events.summary: Differential pipe sticking across depleted Barail sandstone after 25 min stationary surveying.
events.rootCause: Drillstring left stationary against permeable depleted sand with 0.16 SG overbalance; thick filter cake adhered to drill collars.
events.recommendedMitigation: Spot 60 bbl diesel/asphaltic freeing pill with surfactant across stuck interval, jar downward with max allowable impact (180 klbs), maintain low pump rate.
events.actionTaken: Spotted organic pipe-freeing agent, worked string for 16 hours, successfully freed drill collars, pulled out of hole to change BHA stabilizers.

sourceReport.title: Geotechnical Drillstring Incident Report: NWIS-Colve-02
sourceReport.excerpt: Following MWD survey at 3,410m, rotation could not be established. Overpull peaked at 180,000 lbs with zero string rotation. Pump pressure 1,100 psi with full circulation confirming differential sticking rather than mechanical packoff.

events.summary: Erratic torque fluctuations (peaking to 29.5 kNm) and stick-slip vibrations at 3,520m.
events.rootCause: Micro-fractured coal bed sloughing causing ledge development and bit jamming in gauge hole.
events.recommendedMitigation: Reduce RPM from 130 to 70, pump 30 bbl high-viscosity sweep pill, ream section slowly with back-reaming BHA, add 3% liquid lubricant to mud system.
events.actionTaken: Circulated sweeps, back-reamed 30m interval twice, torque normalized to 11.5 kNm.

sourceReport.title: Mud Logging Real-Time Parameter Analysis: NWIS-Active-02
sourceReport.excerpt: Torque sensor recorded periodic stick-slip cycles. Coal cavings observed at shaker screens measuring 2-4 inches with blocky geometry indicative of mechanical stress failure.

events.summary: Historical Stuck Pipe Incidents - Boulder bed keyseating during 17-1/2" hole section.
events.rootCause: Unconsolidated river pebble gravels collapsing around drill collars at 100m spud depth.
events.recommendedMitigation: Pump high gel bentonite pill, back-ream slowly with minimal pull, ensure annular velocity > 150 ft/min.
events.actionTaken: Pumped viscous pill, worked string loose, cased with 13-3/8" conductor casing.

sourceReport.title: Daily Drilling Report: Selt-OW-02 Conductor Section
sourceReport.excerpt: Pebble bed collapsed into borehole during trip out for bit change at 100m. String freed after pumping 20 bbl viscous guar gum pill.

events.summary: Historical Stuck Pipe Incidents - Mechanical bridging in unconsolidated sand.
events.rootCause: Inadequate mud yield point allowing sand cuttings to bed around BHA when pumps were stopped.
events.recommendedMitigation: Maintain Yield Point > 18 lb/100ft², circulate hole clean before connections, rotate string continuously.
events.actionTaken: Circulated hole for 3 cycles, pulled pipe with 40,000 lbs overpull, cleared bridge.

sourceReport.title: Well Completion Report: Selt-OW-03 Surface Section
sourceReport.excerpt: Bridging encountered at 200m depth while pulling out. Mud rheology adjusted with XC polymer to enhance cuttings carrying capacity.

events.summary: Historical Stuck Pipe Incidents - Bit balling and packoff in sticky reactive claystone.
events.rootCause: Hydration of active smectite clays leading to severe bit balling and annular packoff.
events.recommendedMitigation: Add glycol-based clay inhibitor, maintain PHPA polymer concentration at 1.5 lb/bbl, increase nozzle velocity.
events.actionTaken: Treated mud with 3% polyglycol, surged pumps, cleared packoff.

sourceReport.title: Geotechnical Report: Selt-OW-04 Reactive Clay Analysis
sourceReport.excerpt: Extracted core at 250m revealed 62% montmorillonite clay. Linear swelling test showed 45% expansion in fresh water.

events.summary: Historical Stuck Pipe Incidents - Mechanical sticking during wiper trip.
events.rootCause: Tight hole condition caused by ledges formed at sand-clay interface at 250m.
events.recommendedMitigation: Perform structured reaming at 25 RPM with 800 LPM flow before pulling out, maintain hole gauge.
events.actionTaken: Reamed tight spot from 230m to 250m, hole conditioned.

sourceReport.title: Daily Drilling Report: Selt-OW-05 Wiper Trip
sourceReport.excerpt: Encountered 35 klbs drag at 250m depth. Jarred up once, worked string freely.

events.summary: Historical Stuck Pipe Incidents - 20" Surface casing hung up at 150m in boulder zone.
events.rootCause: Borehole tortuosity and keyseating through hard river boulders preventing casing passage.
events.recommendedMitigation: Run casing with eccentric reamer shoe, fill casing continuously, wash down with gentle rotation.
events.actionTaken: Pulled 20" casing, re-drilled hole with roller cone bit and stiff BHA, casing landed successfully.

sourceReport.title: Well Completion Report: Selt-OW-06 Casing Operations
sourceReport.excerpt: Casing string took 80 klbs weight at 150m. Unable to wash down. Pulled casing back to surface to ream hole with 26" hole opener.

events.summary: Historical Stuck Pipe Incidents - Casing centralizer hang-up across 200m depth.
events.rootCause: Rigid centralizers catching on hard sandstone ledge.
events.recommendedMitigation: Use bow-spring centralizers with bevelled collars across known hard ledge transitions.
events.actionTaken: Switched to flexible bow-spring centralizers, landed casing at 220m.

sourceReport.title: Well Completion Report: Selt-OW-01 Surface Casing
sourceReport.excerpt: Centralizer #4 held up at 200m. Rotated casing string 90 degrees with casing tongs to clear obstruction.

events.summary: Historical Stuck Pipe Incidents - Washout behind 13-3/8" casing requiring top-job cement squeeze.
events.rootCause: Thief gravel zone absorbed lead slurry leaving top 60m un-cemented.
events.recommendedMitigation: Pump thixotropic cement blend with 2% calcium chloride accelerator and micro-silica fluid loss additive.
events.actionTaken: Performed 1" macaroni string top-job cement squeeze from surface annulus.

sourceReport.title: Cementing Evaluation Report: Selt-OW-02
sourceReport.excerpt: CBL-VDL log showed poor bond from surface to 60m. Annular squeeze performed with 50 sacks Class G cement.

events.summary: Historical Stuck Pipe Incidents - Conductor pipe vibration and alignment drift.
events.rootCause: High surface vibration transmitted to conductor pipe in unconsolidated gravel.
events.recommendedMitigation: Install surface turnbuckle bracing and pour 5 m³ concrete cellar pad.
events.actionTaken: Reinforced cellar pad with high early-strength concrete, vibration eliminated.

sourceReport.title: Daily Drilling Report: Selt-OW-03 Cellar Construction
sourceReport.excerpt: Conductor pipe inspected for plumbness. Cemented cellar pad to prevent gravel erosion during spud drilling.

alerts.title: ALERT: Approach 3500m in HIGH Loss Risk!
alerts.message: Active well bit at 3,500m approaching sub-hydrostatic Barail Sandstone depleted interval.
alerts.recommendation: Adjust Mud Weight from 1.25 SG to 1.21 SG. Prepare 45 bbl LCM pill on standby.
alerts.triggerCondition: Depth >= 3480m in Barail Formation with ECD > 1.28 SG
mitigationSteps: Reduce mud pump circulation rate to 1,400 LPM
Lower active mud weight by 0.04 SG using water/base dilution
Stock 40 bbl coarse nut-plug & mica LCM pill in pill pit #2
Enable trip tank continuous monitoring during connections

alerts.title: ALERT: Approach 3500m in HIGH Loss Risk!
alerts.message: Correlation with NWIS-Calire-02 shows massive loss of 48 m³/hr occurred at 3,480m.
alerts.recommendation: Adjust Mud Weight. Restrict ROP to 6 m/hr to minimize surge pressures.
mitigationSteps: Cap drill rate at 6 m/hr max to avoid hydraulic surge
Verify shaker screen mesh size (use 140/175 mesh)
Alert mud engineer to keep 500 sacks calcium carbonate on site

alerts.title: ALERT: Approach 3500m in Active Well Risk!
alerts.message: Severe gas kick occurred at 3,495m in offset well NWIS-Colive-04 (18 bbl kick volume).
alerts.recommendation: Adjust LCM, Mitigation & OW-04. Verify BOP function test and choke manifold readiness.
alerts.triggerCondition: Known gas sand boundary within 15 vertical meters
mitigationSteps: Perform acoustic BOP accumulator pre-charge test
Zero pit volume totalizer (PVT) alarm threshold to ±0.5 m³
Conduct crew pit drill before penetrating Barail Main Sand

alerts.title: ALERT: Approach 3500m in HIGH Loss Risk!
alerts.message: Barail Sandstone depleted pore pressure zone (1.12 SG) vs current hydrostatic ECD (1.27 SG).
alerts.recommendation: Adjust Mud Weight. Keep ECD below 1.22 SG to prevent hydraulic fracturing.
alerts.triggerCondition: Overbalance exceeds 0.15 SG across depleted interval
mitigationSteps: Gradually lower mud weight to 1.21 SG
Monitor ECD via PWD tool telemetry

alerts.title: ALERT: Approach 3500m in Active Well Risk!
alerts.message: Differential sticking hazard observed in NWIS-Colve-02 at 3,410m after 25 min stationary survey.
alerts.recommendation: Adjust increase LCM, Mitigation & OW-04. Enforce max 3-minute stationary limit for MWD surveys.
alerts.triggerCondition: Stationary string in high-differential pressure zone
mitigationSteps: Rotate pipe while pulsing MWD data when possible
Maintain continuous low RPM (15-20 RPM) during surveys
Keep pipe-freeing lubricant ready in active mud system

historicalRisk30Days.description: Encountered depleted micro-fractured sand stringer. Mud weight 1.23 SG exceeded local fracture breakdown gradient (1.21 SG). Observed 24 bbl loss in active suction pit.
historicalRisk30Days.mitigationApplied: Pumped 25 bbl fine Mica/Nutplug LCM pill. Reduced pump strokes from 110 to 85 SPM.

historicalRisk30Days.description: Drilling broke into high-permeability upper Barail gas sand stringer at 3,260m. Mud weight 1.18 SG underbalanced against 1.21 SG pore pressure. Gas units surged to 520 with 16 bbl pit gain.
historicalRisk30Days.mitigationApplied: Closed annular preventer. Weighted up active mud system from 1.18 SG to 1.22 SG via centrifuge weighting hopper.

historicalRisk30Days.description: Hydrostatic pressure at 1.25 SG plus dynamic circulating friction induced severe fracture opening in depleted Barail coal-sand interface. Heavy loss rate 68 bbl/hr recorded.
historicalRisk30Days.mitigationApplied: Spotted 50 bbl dual-density LCM pill (coarse nut-plug + CaCO3). Trimmed mud density back to 1.21 SG. Conducted 4-hour hesitation squeeze.

historicalRisk30Days.description: Rotary torque spiked from 14.5 kNm to 31.0 kNm with erratic stick-slip oscillations. Shale shaker screens flooded with blocky sub-bituminous coal cavings. BHA experienced tight hole during back-reaming.
historicalRisk30Days.mitigationApplied: Pumped 35 bbl high-viscosity XC-polymer sweep with 3% pipe lubricant. Reduced string rotation to 65 RPM. Adjusted Yield Point to 22 lb/100ft².

historicalRisk30Days.incidentName: Major Gas Kick & 22 bbl Fast Pit Influx
historicalRisk30Days.description: Drilling break at 3,480m penetrated overpressured Barail gas pocket (1.23 SG pore pressure). Pit level rose rapidly by 22 bbl in 7 minutes. Mud flow out exceeded flow in by 35%.
historicalRisk30Days.mitigationApplied: Hard shut-in performed. Stabilized SIDPP at 320 psi and SICP at 410 psi. Executed Driller's Method kill circulation with 1.24 SG kill mud.

historicalRisk30Days.description: Loss of 38 bbl mud observed over 3 hours due to pressure surge during high-speed connection. Depleted fracture micro-breached.
historicalRisk30Days.mitigationApplied: Adjusted mud rheology with coarse CaCO3 bridging pills. Implemented gentle surge mitigation procedures for pipe tripping.
